exits.description: Added exit variant: disable both closed-bar structural exits (directional close < frozen frontier OR directional close <= frozen sweep low). Keep fixed stop, fixed target and maxHoldBars full exit requested on the final holding-bar close and filled at next bar open. No break-even move or trailing stop.

atrPercentile.description: TR=max(high-low,abs(high-priorClose),abs(low-priorClose)); first TR=high-low. Wilder ATR seeded with first segment TR, recursively updated on closed bars. Rank ATR/close against the previous min(240,bars since segment start) ATR/close values: fraction <= current value. No current observation in reference ranks; reset on gaps.

liveVeto.description: Section 5 veto only: Ad is same-side mass between entry and stop, Fav is opposite-side mass between entry and target, Near is same-side mass in the clipped adverse 5bp band. Veto when Ad >= max(10000,0.01*summary.marginUsd) and Ad/(Ad+Fav) >= 0.75, OR Near >= that material amount. Require valid fresh map and summary, matching symbol/range, exactly 150 contiguous buckets spanning from/to, and full stop-target containment. Allocate mass by interval overlap fraction. Evaluate only the latest completed candidate while its one-bar entry expiry remains valid. Never infer levels for above/below totals. Queue > 0 or LP <= 0 blocks new entries. Zero masses mean no map evidence, not clearance. Preserve historical core candidates; never attach a later map to history.

higherTimeframeTrend.alignment: latest hour with hourOpen+3600 <= confirmation close; must be less than 3600 seconds old
higherTimeframeTrend.rule: long: latest closed hourly close > its EMA20; short: close < EMA20; equality or insufficient history rejects
higherTimeframeTrend.initialization: first closed hourly close in segment; reset on missing hourly bar
